command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; FOUND=0; for i in $(seq 1 300); do if adb devices | awk 'NR>1 {print $1,$2}' | grep -q "^$SERIAL device$"; then FOUND=1; echo adb_returned_after_s=$i; break; fi; sleep 1; done; echo adb_device_found=$FOUND; if [ "$FOUND" != "1" ]; then echo '=== mac usb snapshot ==='; system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -i -A12 -B4 -E 'Samsung|Android|SM-S906B' || true; exit 71; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state; echo boot_completed=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop sys.boot_completed | tr -d ''); echo boot_reason=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.boot.bootreason | tr -d ''); echo uptime=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /proc/uptime | tr -d ''); state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; ST=$(state); echo recovered_call_state=$ST; if [ "$ST" != "0" ]; then python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py --serial "$SERIAL" hangup || true; sleep 1; fi; FINAL=$(state); echo final_call_state=$FINAL; test "$FINAL" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 0 >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd audio adj-mute 8 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; VOICE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n '/- STREAM_VOICE_CALL:/,/Volume Group: AUDIO_STREAM_VOICE_CALL/p'); printf '%s
' "$VOICE"; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'Muted: true'; printf '%s
' "$VOICE" | grep -q 'streamVolume:0'; echo '=== shizuku and app processes ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E 'shizuku_server|pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge' || true; echo '=== recent crash/restart evidence ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -b all -v threadtime | grep -Ei 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime|Watchdog|system_server.*(crash|restart)|adbd|UsbDeviceManager|USB_STATE|reboot|ShizukuCallMedia|aicallbridge:call_media|AudioFlinger|AudioRecord|AudioTrack' | tail -n 300 || true; echo phase2c_adb_loss_recovery_and_diagnostics_complete=true
